title: vaccinium hirtum var. glabrum
intro: Vaccinium hirtum var. glabrum, commonly known as the Himalayan blueberry, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region and parts of China. It is a type of shrub that produces edible blueberries, rich in nutrients and offering various health benefits. The Himalayan blueberry is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help protect against oxidative stress, inflammation, and cell damage. The plant's bioactive constituents, including phenolic acids, flavonoids, and anthocyanins, contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-diabetic, anti-cancer, and cardiovascular protective effects.
